name: poisson_nll_loss
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::poisson_nll_loss(Tensor input, Tensor target, bool log_input, bool full, float eps, int reduction) -> Tensor. Computes Poisson negative log likelihood with optional Stirling-term correction and none, mean, or sum reduction without mutating or aliasing its inputs. Tests cover legacy shapes, zero-sized and broadcast noncontiguous tensors, both input interpretations, special values and epsilon values, dtype promotion including complex inputs, reduction-size boundaries, gradients, and invalid input rejection.
